description: Returns a 0 to 100 forensic risk score, risk band, and source-backed governance, premises, licence-gap, solvency, and filing indicators for a UK company. Indicators only, not advice. Returns JSON with fields company_number, company_name, timestamp, risk_bands, signals, priced_risk, evidence, audit_trail_id, model_version, meta, source, liveUrl, recordDate, validUntil. Each answer states its record date and its source.

companyNumber.description: UK Companies House registration number, 8 uppercase alphanumeric characters.
